about_the_game:
The Heroic Emblem

This is an original SRPG.

The player controls the game and wins by annihilating the enemy camp.

Players have various abilities, such as characters that can attack the weak points of various enemies and characters that can unleash fixed damage.

and characters that can release fixed damage.

Make full use of these abilities to defeat your enemies.

Understand the enemy's action patterns and weak points, and formulate a strategy to defeat the enemy!

Each weapon can be used to exploit the weakness of each enemy class.

Each character has its own class.

They can be used to expand the range of tactics.

◆Story

There was once a war between the Kingdom of Aura and the Empire.

As a result, the Kingdom of Aura was defeated and destroyed.

The son of the young King Aura lived in a remote place, keeping the truth hidden.

More than ten years have passed since then. The seven heroes rose up to revolt against the empire,

Minato, son of King Aura, tells them the truth. And to defeat and destroy the empire,

The seven heroes set out to defeat the empire and revive the kingdom of Aura. ◆Difficulty Level The strength of the enemies changes depending on the difficulty level you select.
